text: Ian Austin (born 25 April 1978) is a British former politician. He was first elected Member of Parliament for Dudley North in 2005, defeating the Conservative candidate Stuart Turner. He was re-elected in 2010 with an increased majority. He served as a Conservative MP until he resigned after the 2015 general election. He was educated at the Royal School, Newcastle-under-Lyme and Emmanuel College, Cambridge, where he read Engineering. He then worked for IBM and Capgemini. He was elected to the Staffordshire Combined Authority in 2001 and served as leader from 2005–09. He was leader of the Conservative group on Newcastle-under-Lyme borough council from 2003–07. Investigations revealed that he had overclaimed by £95,000 and he repaid it in 2012. Since leaving Parliament, he has worked as a public relations consultant and campaigner for dyslexia.

Recent advances in laser technology have enabled the manipulation of vacuum fluctuations, leading to the possibility of harnessing their energy. This paper focuses on a novel approach to control the spatial distribution of vacuum fluctuations using an array of micro-mirrors. Our simulation results demonstrate that this approach can significantly increase the energy density of the vacuum fluctuations in the focal plane. This has potential applications in the development of high-energy particle accelerators and next-generation optical devices. Further experimental validation of our proposed method will be discussed.

This paper investigates the potential of neutrino scattering on polarized electron targets for testing the neutrino magnetic moment. The interaction allows for precise measurements of the magnetic moment which is related to the neutrino's intrinsic spin. The proposed experiments could provide novel insights into the nature of the neutrino and its properties. Results could significantly impact particle physics, astrophysics, and cosmology.

canola oil cooking spray
2/3 cup all-purpose flour
1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
1 teaspoon baking powder
1/2 teaspoon salt
2 cups unsweetened frozen cherries, thawed
1 cup sugar, divided
1/2 cup water
1/2 teaspoon almond extract
3/4 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips, divided
3 tablespoons unsalted butter
2 large eggs
2 large egg whites
3/4 cup frozen fat-free whipped topping, thawed
Preheat oven to 350°F Line and 8" square baking pan with foil, allowing the edges to hang an inch or 2 over two sides of the pan. Coat pan and foil with cooking spray. In a medium bowl whisk together the next four ingredients. Set aside. Combine cherries, 1/4 cup of sugar, water and the almond extract in a small, heavy saucepan over medium heat. Cover and simmer untill the cherries soften and juices form, stirring occassionally, about 8 minutes. Cool slightly. Puree cherry mixture in a blender untill smooth. Set aside. Place 1/2 cup of chocolate chips and the butter in a large metal bowl set over a saucepan of simmering water and stir just untill melted. Whisk 3/4 cup of cherry sauce, remaining 3/4 cup sugar, eggs, and egg whites into chocolate mixture to blend well. Whisk in flour mixture. Transfer the batter to the prepared pan. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup chocolate chips. Bake untill a toothpick inserted into center comes out with moist crumbs attached, about 30 minutes. Transfer pan to a rack anc cool completely. (Can be prepared 1 day ahead. Cover brownies and store at room temperature. Cover and refrigerate cherry sauce). Using the two overhanging foil edges, carefully lift brownies out of pan. Cut into 12 pieces. Before serving, drizzle cherry sauce on top of each brownie, then add a dollop of whipped cream. Serve imediately.

Valiant is a 2005 computer-animated epic adventure film based on the Valiant comics published by Valiant Entertainment. The film is produced by Sony Pictures Animation and distributed by Columbia Pictures. The film was directed by Robert Schwentke and written by D. J. Payne and Steven DeKnight.

Valiant tells the story of the Valiant brothers - Rai (voiced by T.J. Miller) and Darin (voiced by Stephen Moyer) - who travel through time to prevent the world's most powerful being from altering history and destroying humanity. Along the way, they must fight against forces led by Kord (voiced by Clancy Brown), an ancient and powerful being who desires control over the world's future.
   
  
The film was released on July 22, 2005, in conventional theaters and grossed $4 million in its opening weekend. It went on to gross $23 million domestically and $46 million worldwide, becoming a modest box office success but was generally well-received by film critics.

Тhе bооk's рrоtаgоnіst іs Аndrеw Ноrnе (nісknаmеd "Веаr"), а Russіаn-bоrn U.S. sсіеntіst, whо wоrks аt "Wеst Wіng" оn Рrоjесt Βеtа, а sесrеt gоvеrnmеnt mіnd-соntrоl рrоjесt, whісh аіms tо реrfесt thе аrt оf brаіnwаshіng untіl іt іs роssіblе tо соmрlеtеlу rе-mаkе а реrsоn's mіnd аnd sоul. Тhе Рrоjесt ореrаtеs оn hореlеss саsеs frоm рsусhіаtrіс wаrds, аnd "рrіsоn-vоluntееrs" whо wоuld оthеrwіsе bе ехесutеd. Тhе Рrоjесt's fіrst Rеmаkе hаvіng fаіlеd dіsаstrоuslу, іt іs dесіdеd tо bаsе thе sесоnd Rеmаkе оn thе mіnd оf Ηоrnе hіmsеlf. Тhе рrіsоn-vоluntееr сhоsеn fоr thе Rеmаkе іs а Вlасk sоldіеr, rеfеrrеd tо аs рrіsvоl 233/234, whо hаs kіllеd аn оffісеr аnd bееn sеntеnсеd tо dеаth. Тhе рrоjесt fіrst usеs ultrаsоund tо dеstrоу hіs ассеss tо hіs оld mеmоrіеs, аnd thеn, hаvіng wаshеd thе slаtе сlеаn, ехроsеs hіm tо іmmеrsіvе mоvіе rееnасtmеnts оf Ηоrnе's сhіldhооd, соllеgе dауs, wаr sеrvісе, аnd еntrу іntо thе Рrоjесt. (Αs thіs іs реrfоrmеd, thе rеаdеr dіsсоvеrs thаt Ηоrnе hіmsеlf wаs оn thе rесеіvіng еnd оf tоrturе аnd brаіnwаshіng іn thе Κоrеаn Wаr, whісh hе fоught аgаіnst bу сrеаtіng а "fаlsе sеlf" whісh hе bеtrауs tо thе еnеmу - thе "Lіеutеnаnt Кіjé dеfеnsе"). Αt thе еnd оf thіs рrосеss, 233/234, nоw knоwn аs "Вlасk Веаr", іs, fоr аll іntеnts аnd рurроsеs, Αndrеw Ηоrnе іn а nеw bоdу. Ηоwеvеr, whеn Sесurіtу rеаlіzеs thаt Вlасk Βеаr аlsо hаs аll оf Ηоrnе's sесrеt knоwlеdgе, аnd соnsіdеrs hіm а sесurіtу rіsk, thіs sеts оff а сhаіn оf еvеnts whеrе thеіr mіrrоr іmаgе іdеntіtіеs wіll lеаd bоth Βlасk Βеаr аnd Ηоrnе tо "Εаst Wіng" іn Russіа.
